release_name: v0.10.0-beta.2 - Artist Settings & Field Sync Release
features: 🔒 Security: Resolved 10 critical vulnerabilities (werkzeug, python-multipart, jinja2)
🔒 Security: Fixed FastAPI/Starlette DoS vulnerabilities (PYSEC-2024-38, GHSA-f96h-pmfr-66vw)
🐛 Issue #174: Complete artist field synchronization (frontend ↔ API ↔ database)
🐛 Fix: /detailed endpoint now returns all 23 Category 1-3 fields
🐛 Fix: Form properly refreshes after saving artist settings
🐛 Fix: 422 validation error when adding genres/keywords/labels
✨ Feature: Smart string-to-list conversion for genres, keywords, labels
🐛 Chrome Fix: Resolved STATUS_BREAKPOINT crash during video seeking with subtitles
🐛 MariaDB Fix: Updated health check to use mariadb-admin instead of mysqladmin
📋 Versioning: Migrated to SemVer 0.x for pre-production development
🎉 Code Cleanup: 71.4% size reduction across refactored modules
🔧 Installation Wizard: Guided first-run setup with validation
🎬 Video Import: Reliable import system with duplicate detection
📊 Monitoring: Performance dashboard and system health tracking
🔒 Security Scanning: Automated vulnerability detection and remediation
📚 Documentation: Complete user guides and API documentation
beta_notes: This is a BETA release - not yet production-ready
Breaking changes may occur between beta versions
Production release (v1.0.0) will come after beta testing completes
